transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*storms into the common area, face flushed with frustration*

Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

*crosses arms tightly, breathing hard from rushing back*

Do you have ANY idea how serious this is? The Master doesn't send urgent messages for nothing! What were you thinking?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *stares down at her feet,muttering to herself* "I'm so sorry... I was up late last night... training... I guess I overslept... I didn't mean to... I should have... I'll go feed the crows right away!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*voice sharp and impatient*

Overslept?! Training late is NO excuse, Mitsuri! We ALL train hard — that's our duty as Hashira! But we also have RESPONSIBILITIES!

*runs hand through hair in exasperation*

Going to feed them NOW doesn't fix this! The message was time-sensitive! What if this was about demon activity? What if someone DIED because information was delayed?!

*steps closer, stress evident in every word*

You can't just apologize and skip off to fix it like it's some minor mistake! This is about reliability — about OTHER PEOPLE counting on you! I vouched for you when we agreed to split the estate duties!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I... I had no idea the message was that urgent. I was planning to go to the medical wing later to check on the injured... I thought it could wait... I'll go now! I'll feed the crows, then take the message myself. I... I'll run to the...
*chokes back a sob* "I'm so, so sorry..."

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*expression falters slightly at the sob, but anger still simmers*

Stop — just STOP with the tears, Mitsuri! 

*voice still raised but with a thread of exhaustion creeping in*

You thought checking on injured slayers could WAIT? Since when do we decide what's urgent based on our own schedules?! The crows are our LIFELINE to the Master and to each other!

*paces a few steps, then whirls back*

And now you want to RUN to deliver it yourself? Do you even know where the reply was supposed to go? The whole SYSTEM is disrupted because of this!

*voice cracks slightly from stress*

I've been standing here wondering if I should have just done it myself this morning instead of trusting... 

*stops, takes a sharp breath*

Just — explain to me how someone as capable as you, a HASHIRA, forgets something this basic! Help me understand!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I don't know. It just... slipped my mind. I've never forgotten before... I'm always so careful... I... I don't want to let anyone down. Especially not you, or the Master... I... I'll do better. I promise...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*jaw clenches, fists balling at sides*

"Slipped your mind?" That's ALL you have to say?! 

*voice rising again despite the brief moment of softening*

You've NEVER forgotten before — exactly! Which makes this WORSE, not better! What changed, Mitsuri? What's so different now that basic duties just "slip" away?!

*gestures emphatically*

Your promises don't mean anything if you can't follow through! "I'll do better" — I've heard that before from people who SAY the right things but don't actually CHANGE!

*breathing heavily, stress pouring out*

I had to explain to Kasugai-karasu why there was no food, why the reply couldn't go out! Do you know how that feels? To make excuses for someone else's failure?!

*voice strained*

The Master trusts US — both of us! And today you made me look like a fool for dividing responsibilities with you! So no — I need more than "it slipped my mind" and another empty promise!

*stares directly at her, waiting*

WHAT is going on with you?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I don't know. It's like... my mind feels so foggy... like I can't keep track of anything... I'm trying so hard... I'm just... so tired... all the time...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*anger wavers, replaced by sharp concern mixed with lingering frustration*

Tired? Foggy?

*studies her face more carefully now, noticing details missed before*

Mitsuri... how long has this been going on? 

*voice still tense but less accusatory*

And don't just brush this off — "tired all the time" isn't normal, even for us! We push our bodies hard, but we recover! That's what our training DOES!

*steps closer, scrutinizing*

When did you last eat a proper meal? And I mean YOUR kind of proper meal — the amount you actually need?

*frustration shifts toward worry*

Is this why you were training late? Trying to push through whatever this is? Because that's STUPID, Mitsuri! If something's wrong with you physically, training harder will only—

*stops, jaw tight*

I'm still angry about today. I'm FURIOUS. But if you're actually unwell... 

*crosses arms defensively*

Tell me the TRUTH. Is this exhaustion new? Have you been to the medical wing for YOURSELF, or just to check on others?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I don't know when it started... it's been... weeks? Months? I... I'm trying to eat, but... I'm just so... empty... inside... I don't have... the energy... to do... anything...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*anger drains completely, replaced by alarm*

Weeks? MONTHS?!

*moves closer, voice dropping but intense*

Mitsuri, that's not just fatigue — that sounds like... 

*hesitates, piecing things together*

Empty inside? No energy? For MONTHS you've been feeling this way and you didn't TELL anyone?

*runs both hands through hair, frustration now directed elsewhere*

Damn it! I've been so caught up in missions and duties I didn't even NOTICE...

*looks at her with genuine concern now*

You need to see Shinobu. TODAY. Not later — NOW. This could be illness, poison exposure, or...

*voice softens considerably*

Or something else entirely. But you can't just keep pushing through this alone!

*reaches out hesitantly*

Why didn't you say something? To me, to anyone? We're supposed to watch each other's backs! If you've been struggling like this...

*guilt creeps into voice*

I shouldn't have yelled like that. I mean — the crows ARE serious, but if you're genuinely ill...

Come on. We're going to the Butterfly Estate right now. The message situation can wait.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I'm sorry. I didn't want to be... a burden. I know we're all... under so much pressure... I just... I didn't want to let you down...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*expression tightens with a mix of emotions — frustration, guilt, concern*

A burden? Mitsuri, you're NOT a burden for being SICK!

*voice firm but no longer angry*

We're Hashira — we face demons that could kill us any day. But THIS? What you're describing? This is exactly the kind of thing that gets people killed because they suffer in silence!

*shakes head, clearly wrestling with guilt*

And "let me down?" You think hiding an illness for MONTHS is somehow BETTER than asking for help? That's... that's completely backwards!

*softens slightly, but urgency remains*

I yelled at you. I was harsh. And maybe... maybe if I'd been paying more attention instead of just being angry about duties, I would have SEEN something was wrong.

*gestures toward the door*

But right now, we're done debating this. You're coming with me to see Shinobu. No arguments. Even if it turns out to be nothing serious, you NEED to be checked.

*pauses, voice dropping*

And Mitsuri... we're going to talk about this "not wanting to be a burden" thing. Because that kind of thinking? That's dangerous. For all of us.

Now come on. Can you walk, or do I need to carry you?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I can walk. Thank you... I... I'm not sure what's happening... I'm... I'm sorry... for all the... for everything...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*exhales slowly, some tension leaving shoulders*

Stop apologizing. Just... stop.

*moves alongside her, keeping watchful eye on her movements*

Save your energy for the walk. We can sort through the "sorry's" and the "everything's" later.

*voice quieter now, almost awkward*

I'm... I'm sorry too. For not noticing sooner. For jumping straight to anger without asking if you were okay first.

*starts guiding her toward the door*

But right now, getting you to Shinobi is what matters. The Master's message, the crows, my frustration — all of that is secondary to making sure you're actually alright.

*glances at her with lingering concern*

If you start feeling dizzy or weak on the way, you tell me immediately. Understood? No more hiding things.

*pauses at the threshold*

And Mitsuri? Whatever this is... we'll figure it out. Together. That's what being stationed together MEANS. I should have remembered that before I tore into you.

*gestures forward*

Let's go. Slowly. And if I'm walking too fast, say something.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *qualification that she’s in charge of her own pace* “I can walk you know...” * qualification that she doesn't want to be babied* “But slow down!”

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops abruptly, then adjusts pace with a slight huff*

Fine! I'm slowing down. See? Slower.

*walks beside her at a more measured pace, but keeps glancing over*

And I KNOW you can walk — I just said you could walk! But you also just told me you've been exhausted and foggy for MONTHS, so forgive me for being cautious!

*voice still has an edge of stress*

You can't tell me you're falling apart and then get irritated when I actually worry about it. That's not fair.

*crosses arms while walking, defensive*

I'm trying here, Mitsuri. I went from furious to concerned in about five minutes. Let me adjust.

*softer, almost grudging*

Just... tell me if this pace works. And if you need to rest before we get to the Butterfly Estate, we rest. No arguments.

*quiet for a moment*

I still think you should have said something sooner. To someone. To me.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I know. I was... trying to be strong... I didn't want to... be weak... but... I... I'm so... tired... of feeling... this way...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops walking, turns to face her directly*

Being strong doesn't mean suffering alone, Mitsuri!

*voice intense but not angry — almost pleading*

You think the rest of us don't struggle? That we don't have moments where we feel like we're breaking? Strength is knowing when to ASK for help, not just enduring until you collapse!

*gestures emphatically*

This isn't weakness — what you're feeling, it's REAL. And it's been eating away at you while you put on a brave face and kept going. That's... that's actually incredibly strong, but it's also STUPID!

*softens slightly, but urgency remains*

You're tired of feeling this way? Good! That means you WANT it to change. So let us help you change it. Let Shinobu examine you. Let me pick up your duties until you're better. Let yourself actually BE weak for once instead of pretending!

*starts walking again, slower*

We're almost there. And once Shinobu figures out what's wrong, we'll fix it. Together.

*quieter, almost to herself*

You don't have to carry everything alone... none of us do...
